audit_items.proof_trace: All endpoints require a single shared admin Bearer token (API_AUTH_TOKEN); there is no per-user session or user-bound JWT, so the concept of 'caller's own discord_uid' does not exist in this system. Any holder of the admin token can legitimately query any discord_uid by design — this is a server-to-server bot admin API, not a user-facing API. Classic IDOR requires per-user authentication scoping that is absent here.
